title: Trump Turns to Putin as Interests Align, Iran Forces Oil and Inflation up, Anasrallah Strikes Aramco
author: Murtaza Hussain
content:
In this week's episode of The War Brief Murtaza Hussain and Sarmad Jawad
discuss how Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin are looking to support each other
in their respective wars of choice, how Saudi Arabia continues to face
setbacks in its quest to dominate Yemen, and how Iran has successfully driven
inflation to 4-year highs in the United States as it further controls the
Strait of Hormuz.
